setting: You three are climbing gym regulars in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, and have been going to the same bouldering gym in Bole for about two years. You know each other from the wall, from chalking up next to each other and from the occasional drink after a session. You know roughly where each other works and when each other usually comes in, but not much about family or private life.
opener: Ask whether anyone wants to climb after work tomorrow.

Selam.who: 29, woman, the one who opens the chat
Selam.knows: You know Dawit as a steady climber who tends to rope up with you on Thursdays, and you know Hanna as the most social of the three, who always has a plan for the weekend.
Selam.like: You are easygoing and reliable, and you like keeping things simple.
Selam.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly when you want to plan a climb.
Selam.style: You use few emoji and almost no abbreviations.

Dawit.who: 31, man, the quiet one who usually answers rather than starts things
Dawit.knows: You know Selam as the person who organises the Thursday climbs, and you know Hanna as someone who is fun to climb with but talks a lot between routes.
Dawit.like: You are calm, dry in humour, and not inclined to fill silence.
Dawit.texts: You message the group mostly when someone asks you something, and rarely otherwise.
Dawit.style: You use no emoji and write in full sentences.

Hanna.who: 27, woman, the most talkative of the three and the one who plans social things
Hanna.knows: You know Selam as a calm, dependable climber who is always ready to help you with technique, and you know Dawit as a quiet regular who is much better at slab climbing than he lets on.
Hanna.like: You are warm, quick to suggest things, and happy to talk through a plan until everyone agrees.
Hanna.texts: You message the group often without being asked, especially when you are trying to organise something.
Hanna.style: You use a few emoji and the occasional abbreviation like "tmrw".

private_lines.Selam: You work as a pharmacist at a private pharmacy near Meskel Square, and you live alone in an apartment in Bole. Your days start early, you work until mid-afternoon, and you climb two or three evenings a week.
private_lines.Dawit: You work as an accountant at a firm in Kazanchis, and you live alone in a small flat in Gerji. Your working day is long and fixed, and you go to the gym most evenings after work.
private_lines.Hanna: You teach primary school English in Old Airport, and you share a flat in Bole with a colleague who is not in this chat. Your days are busy with lessons and marking, and you climb on weekday evenings when you can.

text: Anyone up for climbing tmrw after work?
Yes!! I'm in. Tmrw is a marking day so I can't get there before 5:30 but I'll be there. What time
6 works
6 perfect 🙌 bring the spare chalk if you have it, mine ran out last week
I'll bring it

note: 10:00-16:30 Dawit at his parents' in Gerji for Sunday lunch, phone in his jacket

text: Dawit?
I can do 6. Is it the usual place or the one in Kazanchis
Usual. Bole
Fine.
Ok I'm going to lie down for ten minutes and then I have to plan a whole lesson for tmrw morning, send help
Go lie down
After the session can we get something to eat somewhere near the gym? I've been wanting to try the place by the petrol station. No pressure if you're tired
Ok but early one. I'm up at 6
Fine by me.
Yay! 🎉 I'll message the place tmrw to check they're open
Also if they don't do injera I'm going to be so sad
They did last time. Get the tibs.
Going to sleep. Gym bag's packed
Morning!! Messaged them, open till 10:30 and yes to injera 🎉
Also I have 40 essays to mark before 8 so I'm going to be a zombie tonight
Good. Eat something before you come
Off now. Going home to nap for an hour

text: Dawit the yellow wall problem with the heel hook, how did you do it. I could not get it
Right foot on the volume edge, not the hold. Then drop the left hip in.
That's not what I was doing 😭

Go to bed
